### God's Love at Work - Week of April 29
Author: Margaret D. Mitchell
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/a-womans-walk/god-s-love-at-work-week-of-april-29.html
Passage: Joshua 1:11
Points:
- Life transitions are not aimless disruptions, but purposeful movements guided by God.
- God provided Joshua with clear instructions, a distinct timeline, and defined direction for the journey ahead.
- Walking closely with the Lord brings clarity to our identity and reveals His specific plan.
- Overcoming confusion and fear requires anchoring ourselves in God's presence and acting in faith.
- Seasons of waiting and preparation are crucial to restore and equip believers for their next assignment.

### Israel Accepts Joshua’s Command
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier.org
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/israel-accepts-joshuas-command
Passage: Joshua 1:10-18
Points:
- Believers are called to obey promptly when God gives an assignment.
- Joshua prioritized preparation over battle plans because he fully trusted that God would deliver the land.
- The tribes were reminded to honor their commitments and maintain unity before crossing the Jordan.
- The people of Israel demonstrated readiness to follow and submit to the leadership God appointed.
- Christians are likewise called to submit to and support the godly leaders placed over them in the church.
